findings.fact: Disabled SourceLinks clears line cache; otherwise layout change refreshes NewOrReformattedLines.
Cache keyed by line.IdentityTag; normal lookup reuses and updates Line; forced refresh rebuilds markers; non-plain-text scans classification strings containing comment.
Timed-out first/next match nulls regex and group slots; exact exception classification and re-enable lifecycle unverified.
Reflection timeout constructor may fall back to regex without explicit timeout; do not promise hard100ms bound.

limitations: Decompiler output is imported as reconstruction evidence and analyst inference; metadata and IL observations remain canonical.

The imported reconstruction is valid only for the exact artifact SHA-256, MVID, method signature, and normalized IL shape recorded here.
Obfuscated names, decompiler variables, and control-flow restructuring are not treated as proof without separate validation.
Metadata counts and reconstruction coverage are not feature completion.
